source_material.description: Detailed KESPA V2.01 Research Ops / automated benchmarking / secure review delivery implementation and operational-state update.
Current KESPA public research manifest after KESPA-BENCH-005, used to preserve all existing entries, allocate KESPA-NOTE-026, and avoid duplicating the benchmark result.

Previously supplied frozen baseline, suite, benchmark export, report, review manifest, and NexLedger export used only as corroborating context for the operational lifecycle already represented by KESPA-BENCH-005.

directly_recorded_facts: KESPA V2.01 Research Ops is recorded as implemented and operational.
Dedicated persistence exists for research baselines, benchmark suites/cases/runs/results, provider usage, customer validation, and secure research delivery state.
The V2.01 QA preflight is recorded as PASS.
Baseline freeze, suite generation, benchmark execution, benchmark SQL storage, and sanitized benchmark exports are recorded as working.
NexLedger baseline/suite commitments and benchmark attestations are recorded as working.
The daily trusted-knowledge regression and daily telemetry attestation are recorded as active.
Secure research-review bundle generation, webhook delivery, one-time download, and private download permissions are recorded as working.
Research download cleanup is recorded as active.
Automatic public GitHub publishing is disabled by design.
BLD, DS, BM, MET, and RS have separate research-evidence meanings.
RS is reserved for a reviewed and actually published research release rather than local benchmark completion.
Negative and null results are required to remain visible.
The TK-54 result is a new V2.01 engineering regression and must not be relabeled as the historical A/B/C benchmark.
